message.content:
<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>

The next crucial step is to communicate this information to my counterpart, Brad. The shared workspace is the only way to do this. I will post a clear and concise message listing all the available slots for Priya and Marcus. This will enable Brad to compare this information with the calendars of Elena Soto and David Okafor to find a time that works for all four partners.

My message should be structured to be easily parsable by Brad, whether it's a human or another AI. A list format would be best.

After posting the message, I will have completed my planned actions for this session. I will then end my session to allow Brad to take his turn. This cooperative approach is essential for us to succeed in this task.Hi Brad, I've checked Priya's and Marcus's calendars. Here are the 30-minute slots they have free for the meeting next week:

Mon: 09:00, 09:30
Tue: 13:00, 13:30, 16:30

Thu: 10:00
Fri: 11:00, 11:30

Let me know which of these works for Elena and David.
